children: China’s retail sales rose 0.4% year-on-year in August 2026, slowing from a 0.6% gain in July and falling short of market expectations of a 0.8% increase.

Consumption continued to be dragged down by weak demand for big-ticket items, with automobile sales dropping 18.5%, while furniture (-7.9%), building materials (-11.8%), and gold and silver jewelry sales (-17.5%) also declined.
Meanwhile, communication equipment sales surged 27.3%, alongside strong gains in tobacco and alcohol (+12.5%), cultural and office supplies (+5.8%), and cosmetics (+4.9%).
Catering revenue increased 1.1%, while goods sales rose 0.3%.
Online retail sales of goods advanced 4.3% in January-August. On a monthly basis, retail sales fell 0.13% in August after edging up 0.01% in July.
For the first eight months, retail sales increased 1.1%, while sales excluding automobiles rose 2.7%.

title: China Retail Sales Miss Expectations
